content.p: A {{animal}} is perched on a {{perch}} {{c_val}} {{unit}} above the ground. It hops off the {{perch}} and lands on the ground about {{land_dist}} {{unit}} away. During its hop, its height is given by the equation:

where x is the distance in {{unit}} from the base of the {{perch}}, and h(x) is in {{unit}}. Set up and solve and equation to determine how far the {{animal}} was from the base of the {{perch}} when it was {{h_target}} {{unit}} above the ground. Round to the nearest tenth.
